prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1332; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you my statement without my name being read into it, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. For the record, can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was at an intersection in Conroe, Texas. I was going straight through a four-way intersection with a traffic light.

Q: What color was your light?

A: It was green. I'm pretty sure of that because I had just started moving after waiting at the light.

Q: What happened next?

A: Another vehicle came through from my right side and ran the red light. It hit the driver's side of my car. The impact was on the front door and it spun my car partway around.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My right knee hit the dashboard and the door frame. It swelled up quickly and I could hardly bend it afterward.

Q: Did you seek medical treatment?

A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the emergency room. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic doctor because they suspected ligament damage.

Q: Have you been able to return to work since the accident?

A: Not fully. I'm on light duty for now, and I can't stand for long periods without pain.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was not speeding and I was paying attention. I want to make sure my side of this is on record.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
